note: nav eval's acceptance set: every walk players reported (issues labelled navigation, the controller's acceptance list) and the caves, mines and Undercity walks quests use, for judging a new walking graph. Run: node tools/polestar.js nav eval --routes tools/lib/nav/eval/acceptance.json [--nav <Polestar_Nav dir>].

Format as routes.json (ends world [x, y, z|null] or { uiMap, x, y, f?, z? }: a zone-map end keeps its z), plus issue (the GitHub issue), tags (underworld: caves, the Undercity, interiors and other underground spaces, the next graph's layer; oneway: needs one-way drops) and outcome (the expected walk in one line). Expectation types beyond routes.json's (compare.js): unreachable, end, passes, avoids (point or area), height; a point or area may be given on a zone map.

Frames: a report's Where line is live (f omitted); a guide goal without 'live' is Era (f e); NPC goals are their CMaNGOS spawns (data/forever/spawnz.json, world yards with height). Thresholds without a figure from the issue are the client grid's walk (data/local/nav4, nav path) x 1.3, rounded up to 10 yd.

Kinds beyond routes.json's: cave (caves, mines and the Undercity walks quests use), chokepoint (a lift, bridge or gate walk), floor (a walk that must end on its target's floor or keep to one: the Undercity's levels, Thunder Bluff's rises and the Pools of Vision under Spirit Rise, Stormwind's canals and Cathedral), bridge (mesa walks by rope bridges: Freewind Post, Darkcloud Pinnacle) and reported (an issue's walk). Ends on water (a boat, a giver on the harbour's edge) are moved to the nearest dry point and say so in their outcome.

Routes already in routes.json are not repeated: raptor-horns(-back) #98, danger-195-tirisfal-springwell #195, auberdine-town-stormwind-boat (C7), teldrassil-dolanaar-felrock-mouth #328, teldrassil-shadowglen-shadowthread-mouth #328, slope-barrens-north-ridge #98, building-stormwind-trade-cathedral #372.
